items.summaryZh: 佩雷斯将缺席本周末墨西哥大奖赛的粉丝论坛，但预计仍将参加周五的练习赛。

items.originalTitle: Sergio Perez to skip F1 Mexico GP fan forum due to illness
detailZh: 佩雷斯因病缺席F1墨西哥大奖赛粉丝论坛
凯迪拉克车手佩雷斯仍预计将参加周五在家乡赛事的练习赛
佩雷斯将缺席本周末墨西哥大奖赛的粉丝论坛，但预计仍将参加周五在Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez的练习赛
凯迪拉克车手佩雷斯在主场赛事前确认感到不适，这发生在队友瓦尔特里·博塔斯因病缺席周四的媒体日之后
博塔斯周五将像往常一样出现在赛道上，但他的赛车将在开幕式练习中交给测试车手科尔顿·赫塔驾驶，作为这位美国人获得超级驾照的一部分努力。
“由于生病，Checo Perez很遗憾无法参加今天在家乡大奖赛的粉丝论坛，”凯迪拉克的一份声明中写道。
“他和车队都对前来观看他的所有粉丝表示歉意。Checo和车队已经决定，今天早上给他额外的休息和恢复时间，以便参加今天的赛道练习。
“他对剩余的周末赛事，包括FP1和FP2的参与不会受到影响。队友瓦尔特里·博塔斯将履行所有媒体职责，并按计划参加今天的自由练习2。
“我们感谢我们的粉丝们的理解和支持，并期待在赛道上见到你们。”
如果佩雷斯无法适应FP1的节奏，那么博塔斯可能会与赫塔一起参加那场练习，同时备用车手周冠宇也在墨西哥。
因此，如果凯迪拉克的两位全职车手都无法参赛，他们还有选择，因为周冠宇自从在令人失望的2024赛季结束后离开索伯以来，仍在等待他的F1回归。
整个赛季对这支美国车队来说都很艰难，这是他们的新秀赛季，他们在锦标赛中排名最后，18场大奖赛颗粒无收，速度也明显慢于其他车队。
但是这并没有阻止佩雷斯续约，因为周三宣布这位六次大奖赛获胜者将合同延长至2029年。
这发生在本周末他即将迎来第300次大奖赛发车之前，而博塔斯尚未确认2027年的合同。
开幕式练习定于当地时间下午12:30开始，FP2将在三个半小时后开始。
detailEn: Sergio Perez to skip F1 Mexico GP fan forum due to illness
The Cadillac driver is still expected to contest Friday practice at his home event
Sergio Perez will skip the fan forum for this weekend’s Mexico Grand Prix, but is still expected to contest both Friday practice sessions at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.
The Cadillac driver is confirmed to be feeling unwell ahead of his home race, and this also comes after team-mate Valtteri Bottas skipped Thursday’s media day due to illness.
Bottas is supposed to be at the track as normal on Friday though, but his car will be given to test driver Colton Herta for opening practice as part of the American's bid to obtain a super licence.
“Checo Perez will unfortunately be unable to attend today’s fan forum at his home grand prix due to illness,” read a Cadillac statement.

“Both he and the team apologise to all the fans who have come out to see him. Checo and the team has taken the decision to allow him additional time to rest and recover this morning, ahead of today’s on-track sessions.

“His participation in the remainder of the race weekend, including FP1 and FP2, is not affected. Team-mate Valtteri Bottas will fulfil all media duties and take part in Free Practice 2 today as planned.
“We thank our fans for their understanding and support and look forward to seeing you on track.”
Should Perez not be fit enough for FP1, it is likely Bottas will contest that session with Herta taking the Mexican’s Cadillac, while reserve driver Zhou Guanyu is also in Mexico.
So Cadillac has options should neither one of its full-time drivers be fit, with Zhou still waiting for his F1 return since leaving Sauber at the end of a disappointing 2024 campaign.
This season as a whole has been tough for the American squad, which in its rookie season is bottom of the championship with zero points from 18 grands prix and comfortably slowest.
But that has not stopped Perez from signing a contract extension, as it was announced on Wednesday that the six-time grand prix winner has extended his deal until 2029.
This comes ahead of his supposed 300th grand prix start this weekend, whereas Bottas is yet to be confirmed for 2027.
Opening practice is scheduled to start at 12:30pm local time with FP2 commencing three-and-a-half hours later.
